newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens sees better ordinary net.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens sees better ordinary net.

text.p: Steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Thursday it expected net profit from ordinary operations to improve in the course of 1997.
"Based on our outlook we expect that the net result from ordinary operations will improve compared to 1996 during the course of 1997," Hoogovens said in a statement.
It said the recovery in Europe was expected to result in moderate economic growth in 1997, which would have a positive impact on demand for steel and aluminium products.
"We also expect to realise high sales in 1997 and furthermore an improvement in the product mix of both our steel and aluminium products," Hoogovens said.
It said that although increased demand was not yet reflected in prices, it expected sales prices to rise in 1997.
The steel and aluminium concern earlier announced 1996 net profit sharply lower at 326 million guilders from a year-earlier 507 million. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
